custom_logic_notes: KWAN is a dual-EMA crossover system. RDP (Relative Difference Price) acts as a trend confirmation filter - longs only taken when RDP is above its zero line, shorts only when below. Signal reversal closes the opposite position. SL/TP values are in points and likely adjusted by 10x for 5-digit brokers (has_digit_adjustment=true). The EA name Exp_KWAN_RDP suggests KWAN crossover confirmed by RDP indicator.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward dual-indicator system. EMA crossover is trivially replicable with pandas EWM. RDP indicator requires reverse-engineering the custom indicator logic - check if RDP is a standard formula (price difference normalized) or proprietary. If iCustom is used for RDP, the .ex5 indicator file must be decompiled or its formula obtained. SL/TP in points need conversion to pips considering 5-digit adjustment. New bar detection uses static datetime comparison - easy to replicate. Position check before entry is standard one-position-at-a-time logic.
